title.narrative: Supporting Indigenous Peoples for a better recognition and realisation of their rights

description.narrative: Contract related to: Supporting Indigenous Peoples for a better recognition and realisation of their rights - Public and corporate governance gaps in global supply chains continue to contribute to unsustainable business practices. The COVID-19 pandemic also shed led on business malpractices and state neglect that affect workers and local communities alike. Disregard for human rights, labour and environmental standards is impeding decent work and sustainable development opportunities for all. The EU is strongly advocating and supporting the implementation of the United Nations Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs) globally and the European Commission has proposed EU-wide mandatory human rights and environmental due diligence which demonstrate its leading role in this area. The EU is also fully engaged on promoting a decent work agenda worldwide notably by fighting off and eliminating child labour and forced labour. As the world¿s biggest trade block, the EU has further committed to improve transparency and monitoring by civil society of its trade policy instruments, such as the EU Generalised Scheme of Preferences (GSP). Finally, the EU upholds the strengthening of the links between biodiversity protection and human rights is a key approach to ensure a just climate transition for all.  Considering these commitments, this Actions aims at enhancing the UNGPs¿ state duty to protect human rights and corporate responsibility to respect human rights globally through better engagement with civil society actorsThis Action will work along four axes of intervention: i) Preventing corporate harm and ensuring corporate accountability, ii) Ensuring monitoring and transparency of the Generalised Scheme of Preferences¿ Special Incentive Arrangement for Sustainable Development or GSP+, iii) Combatting child labour and forced labour and iv) Promoting and protecting indigenous peoples¿ rights.
